cohort: 75 women admitted to a tertiary care center between August 2022 and July 2023 who had self-administered abortion pills
finding: Self-administration of abortion pills was associated with a high rate of complications, including excessive bleeding, severe anemia, and the need for surgical intervention and blood transfusion.
gest_age: Varied, with 26.6% of women taking abortion pills after 63 days of gestation and 20% after 12 weeks
